column1: # Tests/suite-inventory.tsv: every unit-test suite of FernletTests and of ProximityKit's package test target, the
# target and file declaring it, and the s3-wall.yml lines that run it (ProximityKit plan step A0.8). Pinned at A0.8.0,
# before any suite moved, from a full run of FernletTests at ba1675f0 (642 suites, 7034 tests, MEASURED on a Mac,
# Columns, tab-separated: target; suite (the type a selector names); file (repo-relative, the file whose column-0 line
# declares it); lines (the workflow labels whose selectors name it, sorted, comma-joined, or -); cells (a
# ProximityKitTests row's declared test count, its row's in the package's own inventory,
# FernletKit/Tests/ProximityKitTests.tsv, which the package's PackageTestHygieneTests counts across the package's
# files, an extension's included; CIGateSelectorBoundaryTests holds the two rows equal; - for a FernletTests row,
# whose count the lines' floors and the full runs hold).
# Rows sorted by target, then suite. A suite that moves, is renamed or deleted, or joins or leaves a line edits its
# row in the same commit; the wall's per-target row counts change only with an argued, measured change. A new
# FernletTests suite needs a row only when a line names it; a new ProximityKitTests suite always needs one, here
# and in the package's own inventory.
